passage: Friday, 11:40 pm. Said "bro, that is lit" four times today and nobody blinked, so I guess I sound right now. Suraj's group, six of us, sat on the low wall outside school. Suraj dared us to bunk the last period and ride to the flyover. Everyone said yes in a row, Ankit, then Dev, then me. Only Tanvi said "I have a Maths test" and they laughed, and Tanvi went in. I wanted to say I did not want to, but my mouth said "let's go". We went. I laughed the whole way but my stomach was tight. Everyone knows my new slang. Does anyone know me? — Yash

qa.q: Who dared the group to bunk the last period?
qa.a: Suraj dared them to bunk the last period and ride to the flyover.

qa.q: Why did Yash's mouth say "let's go" when Yash wanted to say no?
qa.a: Yash wanted to belong to Suraj's group; the tight stomach shows the doubt stayed private behind the laughing.

qa.q: What choice at the wall might have kept Yash in the group without going along?
qa.a: Yash could have said "not the bunking, but I am in for the flyover another day", or walked in with Tanvi; a light no with one ally is easier to keep.

qa.q: What might Tanvi have felt when saying "I have a Maths test" and walking in while the others laughed?
qa.a: Tanvi may have felt awkward at being laughed at but steady enough to accept it, giving a calm reason without blaming anyone.

grounding: A teenager takes up the group's slang and goes along with a risky dare to belong, while feeling private doubt and unknown.

passage:
Vijay: who is in for the terrace jump video saturday
Kabir: in 👍
Neel: in obviously
Devika: hmm what jump
Vijay: onto the sand pile, easy, everyone does it
Neel: dont be boring dev
Devika: ok fine im in
Devika (to Vijay only): honestly im kind of scared
Vijay: same tbh
Vijay: but dont say it in the group
Devika: ok. wont
Kabir: someone make a countdown sticker lol
Neel: bring ur phone charged dev, we need the angle
Devika: yeah yeah
Vijay: 5 pm at my building, dont be late

qa.q: What did Vijay propose in the group chat?
qa.a: Vijay proposed a terrace jump video onto the sand pile on Saturday.

qa.q: Why did Devika say "ok fine im in" and then admit being scared to Vijay privately?
qa.a: Devika felt pushed by Neel's "dont be boring" and wanted to stay in the group, but felt real fear; the private message shows the doubt behind the public yes.

qa.q: What could Devika or Vijay try before Saturday instead of keeping the fear secret?
qa.a: Either could say a light "not for me" in the group, tell a trusted adult about the dare, or suggest a safer video; naming the worry to one ally is a start.

qa.q: What might Vijay be feeling in admitting "same tbh" but asking Devika to stay quiet?
qa.a: Vijay seems just as scared and worried about looking weak; wanting silence suggests fear of losing standing as the one who proposed it.

grounding: A teenager goes along with a risky dare to belong while privately doubtful, and the private doubt is visible only to one other person.
